proposals.before: Early in Wude, the Hidden Crown Prince campaigned against Wang Shichong; Lin advanced a plan to persuade him; the Crown Prince brought him in to straighten the Classic Books Workshop and appointed him Armor-Cauldron Staff Officer of the Right Guard's Rate Command.
proposals.after: Early in Wude, the Hidden Crown Prince campaigned against Wang Shichong; Lin offered a plan. The Crown Prince brought him into the document office (dian shufang) and appointed him Armor Section Administrator of the Right Guard Rate Command.
proposals.reason: Literal garbles 直典書坊 as 'Classic Books Workshop' and 鎧曹參軍 as 'Armor-Cauldron Staff Officer'.

proposals.before: Emperor Gaozong once reviewed prisoners; Lin's responses in divination and reply left nothing unspoken; the Emperor rejoiced and said: "The key to governing the state lies in using the law: if severe, people are maimed; if lenient, the guilty escape—only by striking the mean can it match Our intent."
proposals.after: Emperor Gaozong once reviewed prisoners; Lin's replies left nothing unspoken; the Emperor rejoiced and said: "The key to governing the state lies in using the law: if severe, people are maimed; if lenient, the guilty escape—only by striking the mean can it match Our intent."
proposals.reason: 占對 means answering the cases under review, not 'divination and reply'.

proposals.before: He ended his career as chief administrator of Yizhou and was posthumously honored as Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.
proposals.after: He ended his career as chief administrator of Yizhou and was posthumously honored as Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
proposals.reason: 太常卿 is Minister of Imperial Sacrifices / Chamberlain for Ceremonials, not 'Grand Master of Splendid Happiness'.

proposals.before: He ended as Chief Administrator of Yizhou and was posthumously given Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.
proposals.after: He ended as Chief Administrator of Yizhou and was posthumously given Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
proposals.reason: Same office mistranslation of 太常卿 as 'Grand Master of Splendid Happiness'.

proposals.after: Pei became prefect of Tong Prefecture;
proposals.reason: Chinese is 沛，同州刺史; English omits that Pei was prefect (刺史).

proposals.before: Lin's grandson Shaoshao, in the Shenlong era served as Erudite of the Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.
proposals.after: Lin's grandson Shaoshao, in the Shenlong era served as Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
proposals.reason: 太常博士 is erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, not of 'Grand Master of Splendid Happiness'.

proposals.before: The empress refused but still demoted him in the historiography office.
proposals.after: The empress refused but still demoted him to a historiographer post.
proposals.reason: 坐史官 is an awkward rendering; context is demotion into a historiographical office after refusing Zhou Xing's death demand.

proposals.before: Shang, whose style was Yisheng or Qiujing, came from a family that had lived in Xinzheng for two generations and thus became a native of that place.
proposals.after: Shang, whose style was Yisheng or Qiuqing, came from a family that had lived in Xinzheng for two generations and thus became a native of that place.
proposals.reason: 秋卿 is Qiuqing, not Qiujing; the idiomatic spelling corrupts the courtesy-name pinyin.

proposals.before: During the Dazhong reign he rose to left vice minister of the Ministry of Personnel.
proposals.after: During the Dazhong reign he rose by successive promotions to Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
proposals.reason: 尚書左丞 is a Department of State Affairs (尚書省) post, not a Ministry of Personnel (吏部) office.

proposals.before: In the Dazhong era he was repeatedly promoted to Left Vice Minister of the Ministry of Personnel.
proposals.after: In the Dazhong era he was repeatedly promoted to Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
proposals.reason: 尚書左丞 is mistranslated as a Ministry of Personnel vice-ministership; it is Left Vice Director of the Shangshu.

proposals.before: Early in Qianning he again directed the government, rising to junior tutor of the heir apparent and Duke of Qi.
proposals.after: Early in Qianning he again directed the government, rising to Grand Guardian and Duke of Qi.
proposals.reason: 太保 here is Grand Guardian (one of the Three Dukes), not 太子太保 (Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent).

proposals.before: Early in Qianning he again held state power, advanced to Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent and Duke of Qi.
proposals.after: Early in Qianning he again held state power, advanced to Grand Guardian and Duke of Qi.
proposals.reason: 太保 is not Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent; that would be 太子太保, used earlier for Shang.

decisions.after: Early in Wude, the Hidden Crown Prince campaigned against Wang Shichong; Lin advanced a plan to persuade him; the Crown Prince brought him into the document office and appointed him Armor Section Administrator of the Right Guard's Rate Command.
decisions.reason: 直典書坊 is duty in the document office, not 'straighten the Classic Books Workshop', and 鎧曹參軍 is Armor Section Administrator, not 'Armor-Cauldron Staff Officer'. The proposal fixes those titles but drops 以策進說 and adds an unneeded (dian shufang) gloss; keep the original persuasion clause and the corrected offices.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 臨以策進說，太子引直典書坊，授右衛率府鎧曹參軍

decisions.reason: In 錄囚 context, 占對 means answering the cases under review; 'divination and reply' invents a divinatory sense not present in the Chinese.
贈太常卿 is a posthumous Court of Imperial Sacrifices ministership; 'Grand Master of Splendid Happiness' would be 光祿大夫, not 太常卿.
Literal likewise misrenders 太常卿 as 'Grand Master of Splendid Happiness'; Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices matches the office.
沛，同州刺史 states Pei held the Tongzhou prefecture; 'of Tong Prefecture' omits 刺史, which the parallel 潛，為魏州刺史 also makes explicit.
太常博士 is Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; 'Grand Master of Splendid Happiness' again confuses 太常 with 光祿大夫.

猶坐史官 means he was still punished by assignment as historiographer; 'demoted him in the historiography office' wrongly suggests demotion while already serving there, whereas 'to a historiographer post' matches the Chinese.
或字秋卿 is courtesy name Qiuqing (秋卿); idiomatic Qiujing corrupts the pinyin, and the literal already has Qiuqing.
尚書左丞 is Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs (尚書省), not a Ministry of Personnel (吏部) vice-ministership; 擢累 is also rightly reflected as successive promotions.
Literal likewise misassigns 尚書左丞 to the Ministry of Personnel; Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs is the correct office.
進位太保 names the Three Dukes honor Grand Guardian; junior tutor of the heir apparent would require 太子太保, which the Chinese does not have.
Literal likewise expands 太保 into Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent; Grand Guardian matches bare 太保.
